That’s why NOW is the time to invest in your own e-commerce website. Own your brand. Build direct relationships with your customers. Control your storefront. Stop relying entirely on marketplaces that can change their policies overnight. I’m not saying abandon Etsy. I’m saying use marketplaces to grow your business, but build a website to protect its future.
